title: Renamed System Utility Executed (OriginalFileName mismatch)
provenance: representative — distilled from SigmaHQ renamed-binary rules (proc_creation_win_renamed_*)
text: Detects execution of a renamed system utility by comparing the PE metadata OriginalFileName / InternalName against the on-disk Image basename: when a known system binary's OriginalFileName (e.g. CertUtil.exe, RUNDLL32.EXE, MSHTA.EXE, powershell.exe) appears under a different on-disk filename, it is masquerading. Anchor detections on OriginalFileName rather than the Image path so a renamed or relocated LOLBin still fires. Counter to Masquerading Rename System Utilities. process_creation logsource windows. Defeats binary-rename and path-relocation evasions.
